name: Guardian cryptic crossword, Penguin book 7 No 58

clue.text: Hard skin? Give us a ring
Couple, eastern, with marvellous type of house
Meanwhile, begin to fire them at random
Brakes when circumnavigating roundabout and bends
Sort of injury revealed by Phil Shaw after crash
Spotted sunken ship minus prow, and took flight round it
Changing position is pathetic
Produced offspring, we hear, making hit
Doctor orated nervously at medium speed
Discharged from service, editor retired, getting jostled
The band always move ostentatiously
Absolute pest, tense, is kept in shade
Seat placed beside sandhill
Purchaser gets change almost without limit
Small farmer getting credit more frequently?
A person learning a German form of Bingo?
American about to catch up the Italian vessel
Female one observed encased in strange metal
Gift of offal for glutton?
To live with no transgression raised divine blessing
Observed rival getting hitched
Prove successful with allure? Don’t be silly!
°E’s in Wales rambling, unafraid
Plot overthrown, one has left in the stampede
Holy city’s in one under the sea
Mean, scruffy set admitted into banquet
Block of shares puts head of household in a reverie
Piece of pottery that’s split (not English)
